description: Notification sent to a student when their misconduct appeal changes status (received, under_review, upheld, denied).
subject: Academic Misconduct Appeal Update — Case $case_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is an update on the appeal you submitted for academic misconduct case $case_id.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
APPEAL STATUS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Case ID:           $case_id
Original Ruling:   $ruling
Appeal Submitted:  $appeal_submitted_on
Appeal Status:     $appeal_status_display
Updated On:        $appeal_updated_on
Reviewed By:       $appeal_reviewer

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

$appeal_status_message

Committee notes:
$appeal_notes

Next steps:
$appeal_next_steps

If you have any questions, please contact the Office of Academic Integrity. Note that, in line with University policy, an appeal decision is final and cannot itself be appealed.

Regards,
Academic Appeals Committee
University Administration
